info.title: Intake Request API
info.description: Creates and submits tenant-isolated innovation intake requests. Operation IDs are stable for Azure API Management MCP projection.

post.description: Creates a mutable draft owned by the authenticated caller. Idempotency-Key is optional; replaying the same validated payload with the same key returns the original resource, while reusing the key for another payload returns 409.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: Opaque retry key scoped to the tenant and caller. A key must never be reused for another payload.
schema.title: Idempotency-Key

parameters.description: Opaque retry key scoped to the tenant and caller. A key must never be reused for another payload.

201.description: Intake request draft created or replayed.

ETag.description: Opaque entity tag for the returned representation. Send it in If-Match when replacing or submitting the draft.

Location.description: Relative URL of the created intake request.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Authentication challenge for the Microsoft Entra bearer token.

Retry-After.description: Minimum number of seconds to wait before retrying.

get.description: Lists the caller's records, or tenant records for a privileged reader, in descending update order. continuationToken is opaque and is valid only with the same caller and filters.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Authentication challenge for the Microsoft Entra bearer token.

Retry-After.description: Minimum number of seconds to wait before retrying.

get.description: Returns a caller-authorized intake request. Unauthorized records are hidden as 404. If-None-Match can be used with a previous ETag to receive 304 when the representation is unchanged.

parameters.name: If-None-Match

schema.description: ETag value from a previous GET response.
schema.title: If-None-Match

parameters.description: ETag value from a previous GET response.

ETag.description: Opaque entity tag for the returned representation. Send it in If-Match when replacing or submitting the draft.

Cache-Control.description: Caching directives for the authenticated representation.

ETag.description: Opaque entity tag for the returned representation. Send it in If-Match when replacing or submitting the draft.

Cache-Control.description: Caching directives for the authenticated representation.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Authentication challenge for the Microsoft Entra bearer token.

Retry-After.description: Minimum number of seconds to wait before retrying.

put.description: Fully replaces an existing mutable draft. If-Match is required and must contain the latest ETag returned by create, get, replace, or submit.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Latest ETag for the intake request.

ETag.description: Opaque entity tag for the returned representation. Send it in If-Match when replacing or submitting the draft.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Authentication challenge for the Microsoft Entra bearer token.

Retry-After.description: Minimum number of seconds to wait before retrying.

post.description: Transitions a mutable draft to submitted. Repeating the operation after it succeeds returns the submitted representation. If-Match is required for the initial transition.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Latest ETag for the intake request.

200.description: Intake request submitted or already submitted.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Authentication challenge for the Microsoft Entra bearer token.

continuationToken.title: Continuationtoken
continuationToken.description: Opaque token for the next page. It is valid only for the same caller and filters and must not be parsed or modified.

schemaVersion.title: Schemaversion
schemaVersion.description: Version of the intake payload schema used by the record.

updatedAt.description: Time the record was last changed.

submittedAt.title: Submittedat
submittedAt.description: Time the draft was submitted, or null while it is mutable.

IntakeRequest.title: Innovation and AI use case intake request
IntakeRequest.description: Captures the core idea and optional discovery details for an innovation or AI use case request.

title.description: A short, recognizable name for the request.

problemOpportunity.description: The current problem, unmet need, or opportunity and why it matters.

proposedIdea.description: The proposed innovation or AI-enabled approach.

expectedOutcome.description: The desired result and the change expected if the idea succeeds.

dependencies.description: Systems, teams, initiatives, approvals, or other dependencies.

risks.description: Known delivery, adoption, operational, legal, or technical risks.

supportingLinks.description: Links to research, process documents, prototypes, or other evidence.

additionalNotes.description: Relevant information not covered by the structured fields.

IntakeRequest_businessContext.description: Business background that helps assess relevance and urgency.

IntakeRequest_targetUsers.description: People who experience the problem or would use or be affected by the solution.

IntakeRequest_valueAndSuccess.description: Expected value and evidence that would demonstrate success.

IntakeRequest_aiConsiderations.description: How AI may contribute and where people remain involved.

IntakeRequest_dataConsiderations.description: Data needed to design, operate, and assess the idea.

IntakeRequest_deliveryConsiderations.description: Known constraints and readiness information for discovery or delivery.

IntakeRequest_responsibleAI.description: Early responsible-AI considerations; not a substitute for formal review.

IntakeRequest_securityAndPrivacy.description: Known security, privacy, compliance, and regulatory considerations.

IntakeRequest_ownership.description: People accountable for sponsoring, shaping, or operating the idea.
